facts.text: I want a ghost story set around a campfire.
I want the story to have an ending where all 6 members survive.
I want the 6 members to include 3 men and 3 women.
I want the ghost to chase or haunt the members.
I want the ghost to stalk through the camp grounds.
I want the ghost to nearly kill two of the members.
I want a scene where the campers run away from the ghost.
I want the campers to come across a rope bridge.
I want the rope bridge to be suspended above a 20 ft drop into water.
I want the rope bridge to snap when the last camper attempts to cross it.
I want the last camper to narrowly avoid death by diving to the end and grabbing another camper's hand.
I want the story to introduce the characters Natalia, Ashley, Jack, Michael, Cindy, and Steve at the camp grounds.
I want the ghost to be introduced and begin haunting the characters.
I want the story to include the near-death rope bridge encounter.
I want the story to lead to the characters escaping the ghost and leaving the campgrounds together.
I want the word count to be around 1000 words.
I want suspense between encounters with the ghost.

events.text: Ghost begins haunting and chasing the campers through the camp grounds.

Campers run away from the ghost and reach a rope bridge suspended above a 20 ft drop into water; the last camper's attempt causes the bridge to snap and they narrowly avoid death by diving and grabbing another camper's hand.

Full story is requested combining character introductions, ghost haunting, rope bridge near-death, and escape from the ghost and campgrounds; target length around 1000 words with suspense between encounters.
